text:
Anya: Quick heads-up — ran a focused throughput/latency sweep for the new reranker+embed combo (7B-INT8 candidate, 768-d embeddings) across us-west1 (A100) and eu-west1 (c6i + AVX512). Results are...interesting.
Sam: Nice, did you compare kernel choices (fused attention vs mem-opt)?
Anya: Yep. Configs:
```
model: rerank-7b-int8
embed_dim: 768
kernels: [fused_attn, memopt]
batches: [1,8,16,64]
regions: [us-west1, eu-west1]
hardware: [A100, c6i.32xlarge]
quant: int8 static
```
Anya: Summary numbers (end-to-end qps for embed+rerank pipelines, 95th percentile tail latency in ms):
- us-west1 (A100): batch=8 -> qps=420, p50=28ms, p95=72ms
- us-west1 (A100): batch=1 -> qps=60, p50=9ms, p95=30ms
- eu-west1 (c6i): batch=8 -> qps=48, p50=60ms, p95=220ms
- eu-west1 (c6i): batch=1 -> qps=6.5, p50=18ms, p95=95ms
Marta: Whoa the CPU p95 variability is huge for batch=8. Did you see kernel-level logs?
Anya: Yes — memopt on CPU triggers large dequant/pack/unpack overhead that spikes with batch>4. Fused_attn with our INT8 kernels on A100 stays stable.
Sam: Any observed quality regression after int8 quant? Eval pass@1 on the reranker?
Anya: Minor drop — MRR -0.8 points vs fp16 baseline on our core dev set. We ran a quick shadow rollout with fallback to fp16 for high-loss queries.
Kai: Can you paste the exact perf command and the env vars? Want to reproduce the mem stats.
Anya: Command we used:
```
./bench_pipeline --model rerank-7b-int8 --embed-dim 768 --batch 8 --region us-west1 --kernels fused_attn --profile /tmp/prof.json
```
Env notes: OMP_NUM_THREADS=16, MKL_NUM_THREADS=16, NUMA_BIND=0, LD_PRELOAD=/opt/fastkernels/libfast.so
Anya: Memory behavior: on c6i the reranker stage hit 90% CPU and swapped to single-threaded kernels during GC spikes. We saw 3x variance in kernel execution time (prof attached in bucket).
Marta: For capacity sizing, does the A100 number imply we can allocate 7 hosts for 1000qps? Rough calc: 420 qps per GPU -> 3 GPUs ~1260 qps. But need spare for spikes + caching inefficiencies.
Sam: Right, for 99.9 SLO we'd recommend 25-30% headroom; so 4 GPUs per availability zone for ~1000 qps with canary fallback.
Kai: Any region-specific routing suggestions? Could we route embed-only to CPU at low load to save cost?
Anya: We tested hybrid: run embedding on CPU (768-d) and rerank on GPU. At batch=16 embedding on c6i gave qps=120 (per host) and reduced GPU time by ~18%, but end-to-end p95 stayed poor because CPU batching latency dominated. Good cost savings only when embedding cache hit-rate >40%.

Anya: Thanks — if anyone wants the raw flamegraphs ping me, I'll share the link. :eyes:
